## About
Fox Meadow English Cream Goldens is a small home breeder of English Cream Golden Retrievers based in Spencerport, New York, in the Rochester / Western New York area. The site covers current and upcoming litter availability, the puppy-raising approach, health testing and guarantees, a photo gallery of our dogs and past puppies, and how to start an inquiry. Verified profile: https://www.gooddog.com/breeders/fox-meadow-english-cream-goldens-new-york
